text: Hello! Lovely to see you. It's Thursday, November 26. Time for the weather! It's Thursday, almost the end of the week. Here in Shanghai, the day will be cloudy with hardly any sun. Tell someone about rain on the window today. That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
